headline: A workspace for groups, learning, and payments.
lead: A subscriber opens a workspace. A member joins a group with a code from that workspace.
leadTa: சந்தாதாரர் ஒரு பணித்தளத்தைத் திறக்கிறார். உறுப்பினர் அந்தப் பணித்தளத்தின் குறியீட்டுடன் ஒரு குழுவில் சேருகிறார்.
subscriberCtaDetail: Open a workspace, then invite members into your groups.
subscriberCtaDetailTa: ஒரு பணித்தளத்தைத் திறந்து, உங்கள் குழுக்களுக்கு உறுப்பினர்களை அழையுங்கள்.
memberCtaDetail: Members register with the code from their group admin.
memberCtaDetailTa: உறுப்பினர்கள் தங்கள் குழு நிர்வாகி கொடுத்த குறியீட்டுடன் பதிவு செய்கிறார்கள்.

services.title: Groups and members
services.detail: Profiles, photos, documents, and custom fields.

services.title: Chat and notices
services.detail: Messages, shared files, and a notice board in English or Tamil.
services.detailTa: செய்திகள், பகிரப்பட்ட கோப்புகள், மற்றும் ஆங்கிலம் அல்லது தமிழ் அறிவிப்பு பலகை.

services.title: Payments
services.detail: Daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly schedules in LKR, for a group or one member.
services.detailTa: குழு அல்லது ஒரு உறுப்பினருக்கு, LKR இல் தினசரி, வாராந்திர, மாதாந்திர அல்லது ஆண்டு அட்டவணை.

services.title: Meetings and library
services.detail: Live meetings, plus videos, notes, and files shared with a group.
services.detailTa: நேரலை கூட்டங்கள், மற்றும் குழுவுடன் பகிரப்படும் காணொளி, குறிப்புகள், கோப்புகள்.

aiBody: Ask a question, set an exam, or write notes. It works in English and Tamil, and the result can be saved in the library.
aiBodyTa: கேள்வி கேளுங்கள், தேர்வு அமையுங்கள், அல்லது குறிப்பு எழுதுங்கள். ஆங்கிலம் மற்றும் தமிழில் வேலை செய்யும். முடிவை நூலகத்தில் சேமிக்கலாம்.
privacyPolicy:
Airo Techhub privacy policy

This policy explains what Airo Techhub stores when you use the public site, the staff workspace, or a member portal.

Who we are
Airo Techhub provides workspaces for groups, learning, notices, payments, and live meetings. A subscriber opens a workspace. Members join a group when that subscriber, or a group admin, accepts them.

What we store
We store the name, email, and phone number you give us, the sign-in code sent to a phone, and the session kept in this browser after you sign in. A workspace can also hold group profiles, photos, documents, notices, chat, payment records, library files, and live meeting participation. Questions you send to AI Teacher are processed with Google Gemini under that subscriber's token allowance.

Why we use it
We use this information to run the workspace you opened or joined, to sign you in, and to provide the features included in a plan.

Who can see it
A platform administrator can manage subscribers, plans, and this public site. A subscriber, and the people they authorize, can see the groups and members in their workspace. Members see the groups they belong to. We do not sell personal information.

How long we keep it
We keep account and workspace data while the account or group is active. A subscriber can remove members and files from their workspace. Ask the workspace admin, or the platform administrator, to correct or delete information that is no longer needed.
cookiePolicy:
Airo Techhub cookie and browser storage policy

This site stores a small amount of information in your browser so it can remember you.

What we store on this device
We store your sign-in session so you stay signed in until you sign out, your language choice (English or Tamil), your theme choice in the staff workspace, and whether you accepted this notice.

How we use it
We use this storage to run the product. We do not use it to advertise to you across other websites, and we do not sell it.

Other services
Live meetings and AI Teacher use the services configured for a workspace. Those services may store their own technical data when you use them. AI Teacher sends the text you submit to Google Gemini to produce an answer.

Your choice
You can accept this notice. You can also clear this site's data in your browser settings. Clearing it signs you out and resets your language choice.
